apple.linePrev: To lay their fruit around my feet
apple.lineNext: And the sugar from the maple
stanza: Lover, when I sing my song
All the trees are gonna sing along
And bend their branches down to me
To lay their fruit around my feet
The almond and the apple
And the sugar from the maple
The trees gonna lay the wedding table

apple.songTitle: You Are the Sunshine of My Life
stanza: Yeah...! You are my sunshine of my life
(Love has joined us...) Baby
(Let's love sweet love...)
That's why I'll always stay around (I've found my baby!)
Can't stop, hey baby...
You are the apple...

apple.linePrev: Hey farmer, farmer, put away the DDT now
apple.line: Give me spots on my apples
apple.lineNext: But leave me the birds and the bees, please
stanza: Hey farmer, farmer, put away the DDT now
Give me spots on my apples
But leave me the birds and the bees, please

apple.linePrev: Sucking the juice from the apple
apple.line: Eating the seeds of the apple
apple.lineNext: Bearing the tree of the apple
stanza: Wrapped in the wings of a sparrow
Beak is as sharp as an arrow
Sings in a whispering whistle
Sleeps in the ivy and thistle
Owls out swooping and howling
Deep in the midnight a-prowling
Mama, the scream of the eagle
Threading my heart through the needle
Threading the blood through the apple
Sucking the juice from the apple
Eating the seeds of the apple
Bearing the tree of the apple
Trapped in the weeds like a scarecrow
Stuck to the wind like Velcro
Distantly hearing the bell toll
Warbling chime through the meadow

apple.line: Eve sucked the juice from the apple
stanza: Mama, the scream of the eagle
Threading my heart through the needle
Threading the blood through the apple
Eve sucked the juice from the apple
Nakedly running, I saw her
Boy chasing after to stall her
I wish I'd have spoken to call her
Before she found fabric to shawl her
Breasts bound and burdened with fiber
Adam came trembling beside her
And he said, and he said
That she has the poison inside her
She talks to snakes and they guide her
She has the poison inside her
She talks to snakes and they guide her
She has the poison inside her
She talks to snakes and they guide her
She has the poison inside her
She talks to snakes and they guide her
